The available tools can provide NMR spectra for the sample, which should contain peaks corresponding to aromatic carbons (typically in the 110–160 ppm region). By retrieving the 13C NMR spectrum and counting the peaks in that aromatic region, we can infer the number of aromatic carbons.</thought>
